subject: Human Evolution
title: Sea Level Rise
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Sea Level Rise.

hook.text: When the ice melted, 120 meters of sea level rose in a few thousand years. Entire worlds drowned.

buildup.text: Doggerland—a vast plain between Britain and Europe—was flooded. Britain became an island only 8,000 years ago.

discovery.text: Coastal settlements where most ice age people likely lived are now underwater and mostly lost to science.

twist.text: Flood myths in cultures worldwide may encode real memories of this dramatic post-glacial drowning.

climax.text: Most of human ice age archaeology lies beneath the sea—a vast underwater archive we're only beginning to reach.

punchline.text: The ocean swallowed most of our ice age story.

quiz.question: What happened to Doggerland after the ice age?
options: Rising seas submerged it, separating Britain from Europe
